title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1973-11-30

ai_review.summary: Harsh audience tape but captures a high‑energy show highlighted by a soaring Morning Dew and an unforgettable Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) source that suffers from hiss, occasional drop‑outs and a thin bass response, yet it still conveys the concert’s excitement. Musically the performance shines – a powerful Morning Dew opener, blazing Big River, tight Bertha > Promised Land, and one of the best Eyes of the World jams of 1973, plus a memorable Dark Star and Weather Report suite. Despite the rough sound, reviewers overwhelmingly recommend this show for its stellar setlist and energy.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently praised with many standout moments; recording quality is noted as flawed but still listenable, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable hiss, harsh/jangly tone, bass‑light mix, occasional drop‑outs (e.g., Sugar Magnolia cuts out), and crowd‑heavy sections; overall usable but not hi‑fi.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opener with a long, beautiful Morning Dew, followed by a mix of rockers and ballads; second set kicks off high‑energy with Bertha > Promised Land and builds into expansive jams.
